note: Explicit report/handoff adoption remains separate. original_path fields preserve original locations only. frozen_ref binds exact retained bytes, including original manifests, failed refresh reports, partial collector output, and initial reports. Opaque snapshots are never reinterpreted as current dependency manifests; failed/partial/stale data does not become a complete current snapshot. Active supporting sources bind durable relative references. Current reports/anchors revisions and publication receipts are added by the orchestrator after this source freeze.
